name: hyperresearch
description: Deep research skill for Codex and Claude Code. Bootstraps the hyperresearch CLI and hands off to its 16-step research pipeline with a persistent, searchable source vault.

interface.shortDescription: Deep research reports with verified citations
interface.longDescription: Installs the hyperresearch pipeline into your project and runs it: a tier-adaptive 16-step process that sweeps sources, investigates the contested points in depth, drafts, runs adversarial critics, patches, and verifies every citation before the report ships. Every source lands in a persistent markdown and SQLite vault that later sessions reuse. Requires Python 3.11+ and `pip install hyperresearch`; the Codex session needs a writable workspace with network access.
defaultPrompt: Research this question in depth and write a cited report:
Compare the evidence for and against
